def merge_intervals(intervals: list) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    # Filter out empty intervals and convert to tuples
    valid_intervals = [tuple(interval) for interval in intervals if interval[1] > interval[0]]
    
    # Handle empty input
    if not valid_intervals:
        return []
    
    # Sort by start position, then by end position
    sorted_intervals = sorted(valid_intervals)
    
    # Merge overlapping or touching intervals
    merged = [sorted_intervals[0]]
    
    for current_start, current_end in sorted_intervals[1:]:
        last_start, last_end = merged[-1]
        
        # If current interval overlaps or touches the last merged interval
        if current_start <= last_end:
            # Merge by extending the end if needed
            merged[-1] = (last_start, max(last_end, current_end))
        else:
            # No overlap, add as new interval
            merged.append((current_start, current_end))
    
    return merged
